items.agreement_note: Kazakh nouns and units never inflect for number after a numeral (e.g. üш теңге, 51 теңге, 4870 теңге all use the singular unqualified noun теңге), and any suffix in the sentence (locative -та, possessive -ы) attaches to the following noun, not to the numeral, so it does not change with the value.
